llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed writing-voice generation helper with limited, purpose-aligned local profile reads and no evidence of malware, exfiltration, or hidden destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The instructions consistently support the stated purpose: loading an extracted voice profile, selecting a register, framing source material, generating text, and optionally reviewing it.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some triggers are broad and the skill may apply silent cleanup to generated text, but these behaviors are visible in the artifacts and tied to the writing-generation workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill instructions and modules only; static scan, metadata, and VirusTotal telemetry show no executable scripts or malicious detections.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Local reads are scoped to voice profile files under ~/.claude/voice-profiles and optional project .voice overrides, which matches the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill mentions saving snapshots only when learning mode is active and using review agents only if requested; no always-on persistence, credential use, or background execution is shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want Codex to use local writing-voice profiles to draft text. Be aware that it may read saved voice profiles, apply automatic wording cleanup to drafts, and save learning snapshots when that mode is enabled; use voice profiles only with proper permission from the writer.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger terms could cause over-invocation, but the artifact's actual actions remain centered on voice generation and do not show hidden data access beyond relevant voice profile files.
[SQP-2] expected: The silent auto-fix step changes generated output before review, which users should understand, but it is disclosed and limited to banned phrases and punctuation in generated text rather than modifying external files or accounts.
